scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n shared,db,ai,queue,api,worker,web -c gray,gray,gray,gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/shared" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/db" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/ai" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/queue" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/api" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/worker" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types --lang typescript --remote --schema public > packages/db/src/database.types.ts && prettier --write packages/db/src/database.types.ts
